recommendations.name: Pie Chart
recommendations.rationale: Best for showing parts of a whole when you have 3-6 categories. Easy to grasp at a glance.

constraints.color: Use distinct, easily distinguishable colors. Avoid too many similar shades.
constraints.axis: No axes needed. Ensure slices are properly sized by percentage.
constraints.label: Show percentage labels on slices. Include category names and consider a legend for clarity.

recommendations.name: Donut Chart
recommendations.rationale: Similar to pie chart but with center space for displaying totals or key metrics.

constraints.color: Use a cohesive color palette. Order slices from largest to smallest clockwise.
constraints.axis: No axes. Use center space wisely for summary information.
constraints.label: Label percentages and values. Add a descriptive title in the center if space allows.

recommendations.name: Stacked Bar Chart
recommendations.rationale: Shows composition while allowing comparison across categories. Works well with multiple groups.

constraints.color: Use consistent colors for each component across all bars. Include a clear legend.
constraints.axis: Y-axis typically shows 0-100% or absolute totals. Keep bars of equal width.
constraints.label: Label each segment if space allows. Show total at the end of each bar.
